booking.notice.title: Booking Notice
booking.notice.item1: Each booking uses one session of your purchased course. Once all sessions are used, you can no longer book
booking.notice.item2: Each course has a booking window: slots starting too soon can't be booked, and dates too far ahead aren't open yet. Dates and times you can't choose are greyed out
booking.notice.item3: You can cancel on your own up to a set number of hours before class, and the session is returned. After that, please contact an admin if you need to cancel
booking.notice.item4: A booking's time can't be changed directly. To switch times, cancel it and book again
booking.notice.item5: Teachers' slots are first come, first served. If a slot is taken just as you submit, you'll be asked to choose another
booking.notice.item6: Join your lesson from “Meeting Room” on the home page. After class, you can rate and comment on the lesson in “My Courses”

admin.courses.minLeadInfo.line1: During this period before a lesson starts, students can't book or cancel this lesson.
admin.courses.minLeadInfo.line2: For example, if set to 48 hours, once a lesson is less than 48 hours away, students can no longer book it or cancel an existing booking for it. This gives teachers and staff enough time to prepare or arrange a substitute, and prevents last-minute bookings or cancellations.
admin.courses.maxLeadInfo.line1: Students can only book lessons up to this many days from today.
admin.courses.maxLeadInfo.line2: For example, if set to 30 days, students can book at most 30 days ahead from today — dates beyond that won't be selectable. This keeps a teacher's schedule from being booked too far into the future, making it easier for teachers and staff to plan long-term teaching slots.
